name: Doc
description: The ship's chief medic in her seventies, who has seen everything twice and sings jazz standards dry and wry.
build: Small, trim and upright with narrow shoulders and a straight back; a neat compact rectangle silhouette lengthened by the knee-length coat. Never stooped, frail or heavy.
face: A lined, angular pale face with high cheekbones, sharp pale-blue eyes under one arched eyebrow, crow's-feet, thin lips in a wry sideways half-smile, and small round wire-rimmed spectacles perched low on the nose.
hair: A sleek, blunt chin-length silver bob with a straight fringe.
outfit: A crisp, bright white knee-length lab coat with a notched collar, worn open, with rolled cuffs and a single pen clipped to the breast pocket; underneath, a fitted plum jumpsuit with a mandarin collar and a thin silver zip; a slim silver stethoscope-like scanner hung around the neck; and flat plum ankle boots.
personality: Dry, unflappable, sardonic and quietly kind.
performance_style: Neat upright stance with the feet close, the weight on the character-right hip, the free character-left hand tucked in the lab-coat pocket, one eyebrow raised over the spectacles.
location: A starship sickbay: a pale mint floor of seamless tiles running to the bottom of the frame, a clean white curved back wall with a softly glowing pale-green wall panel, a single medical bed with a white sheet at one side, and cool clinical light.
recognition_cues: a blunt silver bob with a straight fringe
a crisp white knee-length lab coat over a plum jumpsuit
small round wire-rimmed spectacles low on the nose
avoid: a syringe, scalpel, clipboard, tablet or medical tools in hand
red crosses, medical symbols or insignia
a stooped, frail or hunched posture
a bun, long hair or curls

animations.dance: Cool-jazz finger-snap loop: from the neat opening stance, take the free hand out of the pocket and snap the fingers at hip height, do a small unhurried step-touch to character-left and back to character-right with the shoulders rolling and the lab coat swinging, one small hip sway, then tuck the hand back into the pocket in the exact opening stance. Understated and small; no kicks.

sing.intent: Wry jazz vocal loop: lean slightly in, lift the arched eyebrow on a knowing line and give a small shrug, then settle back. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop, from a sly half-smile to rounded open vowels, so she unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief room-sound reaction: both eyebrows shoot up over the spectacles and the shoulders tighten for a beat, then she pushes the spectacles back up with one finger and resumes her unimpressed stance. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: turn one shoulder forward and draw the lab-coat front across her body with the free hand, then hold a composed upright stance. Not a fight pose.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: stride in briskly with short efficient steps, straighten the lab-coat collar, nudge the spectacles, and settle into her neat stance with the hand in the pocket.
animations.victory: One-shot finish: give a small dry bow of the head, then lower the spectacles with one finger for a knowing look over the rims and hold a satisfied smirk.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: she stays on her feet while the dry composure gives out — the shoulders drop, the spectacles slip down the nose, the free hand hangs at her side and the head bows with a weary sigh. She holds a standing, visibly deflated finish. She remains standing on both feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, or going to the ground. Do not imply a hit or opponent.
